subject: Post-demo: PayGrid pilot economics & next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@paygrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: PayGrid pilot economics & next steps

Hi Amit — great demo earlier today, thanks for walking through the integration. Quick recap and a couple of concrete asks so we can keep the pilot running smoothly:

Summary from our side:
- Trial window: 2 weeks remaining on the sandbox instance we stood up.
- Current observed burn: ~115k tokens/day (mainly inference traffic from 2 integration tests).
- Key success signals: 10k daily active users on the cockpit, <350ms 95p latency, and roughly 60% of queries returning structured output.

Asks / open items (please reply inline):
1) Expected steady-state token volume if you scale the integration to the first 1,000 customers (rough average / day and expected peak).
2) Budget range for production evaluations (ballpark $/month). Helpful to know a soft cap so we can advise on unit pricing and batching knobs.
3) Target unit economic target: what would you need $/1M tokens to look like to make this viable?

We can approve a small, time-limited soft top-up to the pilot if you confirm items 1–3 and share a billing contact. Proposed top-up: $1,200 credit (applied to the trial, expires in 2 weeks) — this is intended to cover a short spike while you validate integration telemetry.

Attached: pilot-usage-snapshot.csv (daily token breakdown from the last 7 days).

If you prefer, we can set a 20–30 minute sync tomorrow to run through the numbers together.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

---
Attachment: pilot-usage-snapshot.csv (CSV, 14 KB)

From: Amit Shah <amit@paygrid.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
Cc: PayGrid Tech <tech@paygrid.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T10:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: PayGrid pilot economics & next steps

Thanks Chloe — appreciate the clear recap. Answers inline below.

1) Token volumes: today’s baseline is ~120k tokens/day. If we enable the streaming endpoint for a small cohort we expect ~280–350k tokens/day within two weeks (peak day could hit ~420k during batch loads).
2) Budget: initial evaluation budget is $5k–$7k/month. If the feature drives conversion we have a path to $20k+/month in Q3.
3) Unit target: to make the numbers compelling for our PM, $/1M tokens in the range of $700–$900 is ideal.

We’d like the soft top-up to cover a planned load test on Wednesday (we’ll likely consume ~600k tokens that day). Can you increase the proposed top-up to account for that?

Also attaching our billing contact and PO routing for your finance team.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Amit Shah
Head of Integrations | PayGrid
amit@paygrid.com | +1 (617) 555-0228

---
Attachment: billing-contact.pdf (PDF, 9 KB)
